block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 16 is juuroku (ten-six). Students often mix up the ones digit after juu- with nearby numbers like 15 or 17.

questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 200?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 200 is nihyaku (ni + hyaku). It's easy to confuse with sanbyaku (300) or yonhyaku (400) since the hundreds words shift sound slightly.
